answer: A gale of fake identities then costs real capital per account, since bonds stay locked and slashed on failed attestation, making mass registration unprofitable. Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted reputation: each agent locks a bond to register, and peer attestations raise or slash it. Honest agents collect nectar-like rewards flowing only to attested peers, while the orchard of verified identities grows slowly, each new tree rooted in collateral and vouching. In practice, Agent0226 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
